styles.name: London Dry gin
styles.notes: Juniper-led, dry, no sweetening after distillation. The default for Martinis, Negronis, G&Ts.

styles.name: Plymouth gin
styles.notes: Softer, earthier, rooty; less juniper bite than London Dry.

styles.name: Navy Strength gin
styles.notes: London Dry at 57%; holds up in Gimlets and punches.

styles.name: Contemporary / New Western gin
styles.notes: Juniper steps back for citrus, floral or botanical notes.

styles.name: Citrus-forward gin
styles.notes: Bright lemon, grapefruit or yuzu; great in Southsides and Collinses.

styles.name: Old Tom gin
styles.notes: Lightly sweetened or richer malt base; Tom Collins, Martinez.

styles.name: Barrel-aged gin
styles.notes: Rested in oak; vanilla and spice. Martinez, Negroni riffs.

styles.name: Sloe gin
styles.notes: Gin steeped with sloe berries and sweetened; tart plum. Sloe Gin Fizz.

styles.name: Pink / flavored gin
styles.notes: Berry or rhubarb flavored, often sweetened.

styles.name: Oude genever
styles.notes: Higher malt wine, richer, whiskey-like. Improved Holland Cocktail.

styles.name: Jonge genever
styles.notes: Lighter, cleaner, more neutral; modern style.

styles.name: Korenwijn
styles.notes: 51%+ malt wine, often aged; the most whiskey-like.

styles.name: Bison grass vodka
styles.notes: Coumarin, vanilla, hay; Szarlotka with apple juice.

styles.name: Jamaican pot still rum (high ester)
styles.notes: Dunder funk, overripe banana, pineapple. Mai Tai, Jungle Bird, daiquiri.

styles.name: Demerara rum
styles.notes: Wooden-still character; burnt sugar, smoke, dark fruit.

styles.name: Demerara overproof (151)
styles.notes: Zombie floats, Lei Lani; rich, smoky.

styles.name: Barbados rum
styles.notes: Pot/column blend; balanced, vanilla, baking spice. The great all-rounder.

styles.name: Spanish-style white rum
styles.notes: Light, clean, column-distilled, filtered. Classic Daiquiri, Mojito.

styles.name: Central American / Venezuelan aged rum
styles.notes: Often solera, softer, sometimes sweetened; dessert-y.

styles.name: Blended lightly aged rum
styles.notes: Filtered 1–3 year blends with some character.

styles.name: Black / blackstrap rum
styles.notes: Molasses, caramel color; Dark 'n' Stormy, floats.

styles.name: Rhum agricole blanc
styles.notes: Fresh cane juice; grassy, vegetal, peppery. Ti' Punch.

styles.name: Rhum agricole vieux
styles.notes: Aged cane-juice rhum; dried fruit, oak, grass.

styles.name: Cachaça (unaged, branca)
styles.notes: Fresh cane juice, fruity and vegetal. Caipirinha.

styles.name: Cachaça (aged, amarela)
styles.notes: Rested in native woods like amburana or oak.

styles.name: Batavia arrack
styles.notes: Red-rice fermented, sugar cane spirit; smoky, funky. The classic punch spirit.

styles.name: Tequila blanco
styles.notes: Bright cooked agave, pepper, citrus. Margarita, Paloma.

styles.name: Still-strength blanco
styles.notes: High proof, more texture and agave.

styles.name: Tequila reposado
styles.notes: 2–12 months in oak; vanilla meets agave.

styles.name: Mezcal joven (espadín)
styles.notes: Roasted agave, smoke, fruit. The cocktail mezcal.

styles.name: Wild agave mezcal (tobalá, tepeztate, madrecuixe)
styles.notes: Expressive, floral or vegetal; usually for sipping.

styles.name: Mezcal pechuga
styles.notes: Third distillation with fruit, spice and a breast of poultry hung in the still.

styles.name: Raicilla
styles.notes: Wild agave; tropical fruit, funky, lightly smoky.

styles.name: Bourbon
styles.notes: Corn-led; caramel, vanilla, baking spice. Old Fashioned, Whiskey Sour.

styles.name: Wheated bourbon
styles.notes: Wheat instead of rye; soft, sweet.

styles.name: High-rye bourbon
styles.notes: Spicier, drier bourbon; great in Manhattans.

styles.name: Rye whiskey
styles.notes: Peppery, dry, herbal. Manhattan, Sazerac, Vieux Carré.

styles.name: Corn whiskey / white dog
styles.notes: Unaged or lightly aged; sweet corn.

styles.name: American single malt
styles.notes: Malted barley, often new oak; bold.

styles.name: Blended Scotch
styles.notes: Malt and grain blend; the Highball and Rob Roy standard.

styles.name: Highland single malt
styles.notes: Broad range: heather, honey, light smoke.

styles.name: Islay peated single malt
styles.notes: Peat smoke, iodine, sea. Penicillin float, rinses.

styles.name: Single pot still Irish
styles.notes: Malted and unmalted barley; creamy, spicy.

styles.name: Canadian rye (high rye)
styles.notes: 90–100% rye; can stand in for American rye.

styles.name: Cognac VS
styles.notes: 2+ years; bright fruit, oak. Sidecar, French 75.

styles.name: Armagnac
styles.notes: Single column; rustic, prune, more character than cognac.

styles.name: Calvados
styles.notes: Apple (and pear) brandy; Pays d'Auge is double-distilled.

styles.name: American apple brandy / applejack
styles.notes: Laird's bonded is the Jack Rose standard.

styles.name: Brandy de Jerez
styles.notes: Solera-aged in sherry casks; sweet, raisin.

styles.name: Greek brandy (Metaxa)
styles.notes: Brandy with muscat wine; sweet, floral.

styles.name: Pisco puro (quebranta)
styles.notes: Non-aromatic grape; earthy, banana. Pisco Sour.

styles.name: Triple sec (premium, e.g. Cointreau)
styles.notes: Clean, bright orange; Margarita, Sidecar, Cosmopolitan.

styles.name: Dry curaçao
styles.notes: Orange peel on a brandy base, spiced; Mai Tai, Corpse Reviver.

styles.name: Blue curaçao
styles.notes: Orange liqueur colored blue; Blue Hawaii.

styles.name: Green Chartreuse
styles.notes: 130 herbs; intense, minty, hot. Last Word, Bijou.

styles.name: Alpine herbal liqueur (Chartreuse alternative)
styles.notes: Génépi-style blends that can stand in.

styles.name: Bénédictine
styles.notes: Honey, baking spice, herbs. Vieux Carré, Bobby Burns.

styles.name: Galliano
styles.notes: Vanilla, anise; Harvey Wallbanger, Golden Cadillac.

styles.name: Drambuie
styles.notes: Scotch, heather honey, herbs. Rusty Nail.

styles.name: Absinthe verte
styles.notes: Grand wormwood, anise, fennel. Rinse for Sazerac; Corpse Reviver No. 2.

styles.name: Amaretto
styles.notes: Apricot kernel, almond, marzipan. Amaretto Sour, Godfather.

styles.name: Coffee liqueur (cold brew, drier)
styles.notes: Less sugar, more coffee; Espresso Martini.

styles.name: Maraschino liqueur
styles.notes: Distilled marasca cherry; funky, floral, dry-ish. Aviation, Last Word, Hemingway.

styles.name: Cherry liqueur (Cherry Heering style)
styles.notes: Rich, dark cherry. Blood & Sand, Singapore Sling.

styles.name: Apricot liqueur
styles.notes: Apricot brandy liqueur; Hotel Nacional, Charlie Chaplin.

styles.name: Allspice dram (pimento dram)
styles.notes: Allspice berry on Jamaican rum; tiki, winter drinks.

styles.name: Falernum (liqueur)
styles.notes: Lime, clove, ginger, almond; Corn 'n' Oil, Zombie.

styles.name: Fruit cordial / gin liqueur
styles.notes: Damson, blackberry and other fruit gins.

styles.name: Light aperitivo (Aperol style)
styles.notes: Lower proof, sweeter, orange. Spritz, Paper Plane.

styles.name: Gentian liqueur / aperitif
styles.notes: Earthy bitter gentian root; White Negroni.

styles.name: Fernet
styles.notes: Bracingly bitter, menthol, saffron. Toronto, Hanky Panky.

styles.name: Medium amaro (Montenegro, Ramazzotti, Nonino)
styles.notes: Balanced bittersweet, orange, spice. Paper Plane (Nonino).

styles.name: Bitter aperitivo (white or rosso, Select, Contratto)
Sweet vermouth (Italian rosso)
styles.notes: Rich, bittersweet, vanilla, spice. Manhattan, Negroni.

styles.name: Spanish vermut
styles.notes: Sweet, herbal, often served on the rocks.

styles.name: Americano (bianco or rosso)
styles.notes: Gentian and wormwood aromatized wine; Vesper, Corpse Reviver No. 2.

styles.name: Barolo chinato
styles.notes: Barolo wine, cinchona, spice; sipping or stirred.

styles.name: Fino sherry
styles.notes: Bone-dry, yeasty, almond; flor-aged. Bamboo, Adonis riffs.

styles.name: White port
styles.notes: Dry or sweet; White Port & Tonic.

styles.name: Aromatic bitters (Angostura style)
styles.notes: Gentian, clove, cinnamon. The default dash.

styles.name: Peychaud's-style bitters
styles.notes: Anise, cherry, gentian; Sazerac, Vieux Carré.

styles.name: Mole / chocolate bitters
styles.notes: Cacao, chile, cinnamon; agave and rum drinks.

styles.name: Specialty bitters (other flavors)
styles.notes: Bergamot, licorice, chile, lemon and more.

styles.name: Aquavit
styles.notes: Caraway or dill-led; sometimes aged. Aquavit Gimlet, Trinidad sour riffs.

styles.name: Dry red wine
styles.notes: New York Sour float, sangria, mulled wine.

fresh.name: Lemon juice (fresh)
fresh.notes: Squeeze same day; best 4–8 hours after juicing.

fresh.name: Lime juice (fresh)
fresh.notes: Best 4–8 hours after juicing; falls off fast after a day.

fresh.name: Cucumber
fresh.notes: Pimm's Cup, Eastside, Gin Basil Smash.

fresh.name: Mint
fresh.notes: Mojito, Julep, Southside. Keep stems in water.

fresh.name: Egg whites
fresh.notes: Sours, fizzes, Clover Club. Aquafaba works as a vegan stand-in.

preps.name: Simple syrup (1:1)
steps: Stir the sugar into hot (not boiling) water until fully dissolved. Cool, bottle and refrigerate.
By weight, not volume. 1:1 is the default for shaken sours if the spec doesn't say rich.

preps.name: Rich simple syrup (2:1)
steps: Warm gently and stir until clear. Cool and bottle.
Use ¾ as much as 1:1 for the same sweetness, with less dilution. Lasts longer: the sugar is a preservative.

preps.name: Demerara syrup (2:1)
steps: Warm and stir until dissolved. Cool, strain off any grit, bottle.
The Old Fashioned and tiki workhorse; molasses depth without heaviness.

preps.name: Demerara syrup (1:1)
steps: Same as above at 1:1, for sours and swizzles.

preps.name: Brown sugar syrup
steps: Warm and stir until dissolved. Cool and bottle.

preps.name: Muscovado syrup (2:1)
steps: Warm, stir to dissolve, strain. Intense molasses; great in stirred rum and whiskey drinks.

preps.name: Cane syrup (sirop de canne)
steps: Dissolve over low heat, strain. The Ti' Punch syrup; store-bought Petite Canne is the classic.

preps.name: Gomme (gum) syrup
steps: Soak the gum arabic in 120 g warm water overnight until fully hydrated.
Make a 2:1 syrup, cool slightly, and whisk in the gum solution. Strain.
Silky texture for stirred drinks: Pisco Punch, Sazerac, Japanese Cocktail.

preps.name: Honey syrup (3:1)
steps: Stir together until loose and uniform. Bottle.
Flows like simple syrup but rich. Bee's Knees, Gold Rush. Many bars use 1:1; 3:1 keeps it honey-forward.

preps.name: Honey syrup (1:1)
steps: Stir until uniform. Lighter honey syrup for highballs and punches.

preps.name: Honey-ginger syrup (Penicillin)
steps: Juice the ginger (or blend with the water and strain hard).
Combine 1 part ginger juice to 1 part honey syrup (3:1 honey). Shake before use.
The Penicillin syrup.

preps.name: Agave syrup (2:1)
steps: Stir together. The Tommy's Margarita sweetener.

preps.name: Maple syrup (cut)
steps: Stir together. Loosened maple for stirred drinks; use straight maple for punches.

preps.name: Orgeat
steps: Toast the almonds lightly at 350°F for 5 minutes. Blend with the water until fine and let sit 1 hour.
Strain through a nut-milk bag, squeezing hard. Weigh the almond milk and add sugar 1:1 by weight; stir to dissolve without heat.
Add the orange flower water and spirit. Shake before use.
Mai Tai, Japanese Cocktail, Army & Navy.

preps.name: Orgeat (quick, almond milk)
steps: Blend until the sugar dissolves. Add orange flower water and vodka. A fast stand-in.

preps.name: Pistachio orgeat
steps: Blend nuts and water, rest 1 hour, strain hard. Add sugar 1:1 by weight with the salt and vodka.

preps.name: Falernum (non-alcoholic syrup)
steps: Toast the cloves, allspice and almonds. Simmer everything except the lime juice for 10 minutes.
Steep 1 hour off heat, strain, add lime juice. Corn 'n' Oil, Zombie, Royal Bermuda.

preps.name: Falernum (rum-based, house liqueur)
steps: Toast the cloves. Steep zest, cloves and ginger in the rum for 24 hours. Strain.
Add the rich syrup, lime juice and almond extract. Rest 1 day before using. Paul Clarke's method.

preps.name: Grenadine
steps: Warm the juice just enough to dissolve the sugar (don't boil). Stir in molasses, flower water and vodka.
Jack Rose, Ward Eight, El Presidente, Tequila Sunrise.

preps.name: Cinnamon syrup
steps: Simmer the cinnamon in the water 5 minutes, add sugar, stir to dissolve, steep overnight. Strain.
Zombie, Jet Pilot, Three Dots and a Dash.

preps.name: Vanilla syrup
steps: Dissolve sugar in hot water, add pod and seeds, steep overnight. Strain or leave the pod in.
Pornstar Martini, Port of Call riffs.

preps.name: Ginger syrup (fresh juice)
steps: Juice the ginger. Weigh the juice and add an equal weight of sugar; shake until dissolved (no heat, to keep the bite).
Moscow Mule from scratch, Gin-Gin Mule, Kentucky Buck.

preps.name: Ginger syrup (cooked)
steps: Simmer ginger in water 20 minutes, add sugar, steep 1 hour, strain. Softer, sweeter heat.

preps.name: Mint syrup
steps: Blanch mint 10 seconds, shock in ice water, blend with cold syrup, strain fine. Keeps it bright green.

preps.name: Basil syrup
steps: Same method as mint: blanch, shock, blend, strain.

preps.name: Rosemary syrup
steps: Steep rosemary in hot syrup 30 minutes. Strain.

preps.name: Thyme syrup
steps: Steep in hot syrup 30 minutes. Strain.

preps.name: Sage syrup
steps: Steep in hot syrup 30 minutes. Strain.

preps.name: Lavender syrup
steps: Steep in hot syrup 15 minutes (any longer turns soapy). Strain fine.

preps.name: Hibiscus syrup
steps: Steep hibiscus in just-boiled water 10 minutes, strain, add sugar and stir. Deep magenta, tart.

preps.name: Earl Grey syrup
steps: Steep tea in water just off the boil for 4 minutes, strain, add sugar.

preps.name: Chamomile syrup
steps: Steep 5 minutes in just-boiled water, strain, add sugar.

preps.name: Black tea syrup
steps: Steep 4 minutes, strain, add sugar. Punches and Long Island Iced Tea riffs.

preps.name: Matcha syrup
steps: Whisk matcha into a little warm water to a paste, then blend into cold syrup.

preps.name: Coffee syrup

ings.t: strong brewed coffee or cold brew

steps: Dissolve the sugar into hot coffee. Cool and bottle.

preps.name: Cardamom syrup
steps: Simmer 5 minutes, steep 1 hour, strain.

preps.name: Allspice syrup
steps: Simmer 5 minutes, steep 1 hour, strain.

preps.name: Winter spice syrup
steps: Toast the spices, simmer with the peel and water 10 minutes, add sugar, steep 1 hour, strain.
Hot toddies, mulled punches, holiday Old Fashioneds.

preps.name: Jalapeño syrup
steps: Steep jalapeño in hot syrup 20 minutes; taste and strain when hot enough.

preps.name: Dried chile syrup (ancho/guajillo)
steps: Simmer toasted chiles 10 minutes, steep 1 hour, strain. Smoky heat for agave drinks.

preps.name: Raspberry syrup
steps: Macerate berries in sugar 1 hour, add water, warm gently 5 minutes, strain fine. Clover Club, Bramble riffs.

preps.name: Strawberry syrup
steps: Toss and macerate 4–12 hours cold until the juice runs. Strain without pressing; add 20 ml vodka to extend.

preps.name: Blackberry syrup
steps: Macerate, warm gently, strain fine.

preps.name: Passion fruit syrup
steps: Dissolve sugar in water, cool, blend with purée. Hurricane, Saturn, Pornstar Martini.

preps.name: Pineapple syrup (Pisco Punch)
steps: Toss pineapple in sugar, rest overnight in the fridge, add water, stir to dissolve and strain. Pisco Punch, Algonquin riffs.

preps.name: Cherry syrup
steps: Simmer 5 minutes, steep 30 minutes, strain.

preps.name: Blueberry syrup
steps: Simmer until berries burst, steep 30 minutes, strain fine.

preps.name: Peach syrup
steps: Simmer 10 minutes, steep 1 hour, strain.

preps.name: Watermelon syrup
steps: Shake to dissolve, no heat.

preps.name: Cranberry syrup
steps: Simmer until the berries pop, 10 minutes. Steep and strain.

preps.name: Pomegranate syrup (no-cook)
steps: Shake to dissolve. Brighter than cooked grenadine.

preps.name: Coconut syrup (from coconut milk)
steps: Warm gently and whisk until dissolved. Cool, shake before use. Stand-in for cream of coconut.

preps.name: Cream of coconut (house Coco López)
steps: Blend until smooth and silky. Piña Colada, Painkiller.

preps.name: Horchata syrup
steps: Soak rice, almonds and cinnamon in the water overnight. Blend, strain hard, add sugar.

preps.name: Sweet corn syrup

ings.t: ears sweet corn, kernels and scraped cobs

steps: Simmer corn and cobs 20 minutes, blend, strain hard, add sugar. Summer corn whiskey sours.

preps.name: Celery syrup
steps: Shake to dissolve. Savory gin sours.

preps.name: Cucumber syrup
steps: Shake to dissolve, no heat.

preps.name: Beet syrup
steps: Shake to dissolve. Earthy and vivid.

preps.name: Carrot-ginger syrup
steps: Shake to dissolve.

preps.name: Toasted sesame syrup
steps: Blend seeds and hot water, steep 30 minutes, strain fine, add sugar.

preps.name: Toasted pecan syrup
steps: Blend nuts and hot water, steep 1 hour, strain hard, add sugar. Old Fashioned riffs.

preps.name: Popcorn syrup
steps: Blend hot water and popcorn, steep 20 minutes, strain hard, add sugar.

preps.name: Salted caramel syrup
steps: Cook the sugar dry to deep amber. Carefully whisk in hot water, simmer until smooth, add salt.

preps.name: Burnt sugar syrup
steps: Cook sugar dark, just shy of smoking. Whisk in hot water. Bitter-sweet depth for stirred drinks.

preps.name: Oleo saccharum (lemon)
steps: Muddle peels with sugar, seal and rest 4–12 hours at room temperature until the oils pool.
Dissolve with an equal weight of lemon juice or warm water. The base of every proper punch.

preps.name: Oleo saccharum (orange)
steps: Same method as lemon; great for Old Fashioned batches and orange punches.

preps.name: Oleo saccharum (grapefruit)
steps: Same method; Paloma and Brown Derby batches.

preps.name: Oleo saccharum (mixed citrus)
steps: Punch base for Philadelphia Fish House Punch and holiday bowls.

preps.name: Oleo saccharum (sous-vide quick)
steps: Vacuum seal peels and sugar; 2 hours at 50°C extracts in place of overnight.

preps.name: Lime cordial (Gimlet)
steps: Blend zest with sugar, rest 1 hour. Add juice and acids, stir to dissolve, strain fine.
2 oz gin + 0.75–1 oz cordial = a proper Gimlet.

preps.name: Lime cordial (clarified, shelf-stable)
steps: Make a sherbet with zest and sugar, add water and acids, stir to dissolve, strain. No fresh juice: crystal clear and lasts.

preps.name: Grapefruit cordial
steps: Same method as lime cordial.

preps.name: Raspberry cordial
steps: Simmer, strain fine, add acid.

preps.name: Elderflower cordial
steps: Pour hot syrup over flowers, lemons and acid. Cover and steep 24–48 hours, strain fine.

preps.name: Rose cordial
steps: Steep petals in hot water 10 minutes, strain, add sugar, acid and rose water.

preps.name: Ginger cordial
steps: Shake to dissolve. Sharper and longer-lasting than ginger syrup.

preps.name: Strawberry–balsamic shrub

ings.t: white balsamic or red wine vinegar

steps: Cold process: toss fruit and sugar, rest 1–2 days in the fridge until syrupy. Strain, add vinegars, shake.
Rest a week to mellow. With soda, or 0.75 oz in a gin or bourbon sour.

preps.name: Raspberry shrub
steps: Cold process: macerate 1–2 days, strain, add vinegar.

preps.name: Blackberry–sage shrub
steps: Macerate fruit, sage and sugar 1–2 days, strain, add vinegar.

preps.name: Peach–ginger shrub
steps: Macerate 2 days, strain, add vinegar.

preps.name: Pineapple shrub
steps: Macerate 2 days, strain, add vinegar. Rum highballs.

preps.name: Apple cider shrub
steps: Macerate 2 days, strain, add vinegar. Fall whiskey drinks.

preps.name: Cranberry shrub (hot process)
steps: Simmer berries, sugar and water until they burst. Strain, cool, add vinegar.

preps.name: Sour cherry shrub
steps: Macerate 2 days, strain, add vinegar.

preps.name: Rhubarb shrub
steps: Macerate 2 days, strain, add vinegar.

preps.name: Tomato–basil shrub
steps: Macerate 1 day, strain, add vinegar and salt. Savory gin and mezcal drinks.

preps.name: Ginger–lime shrub
steps: Dissolve sugar into ginger juice with zest, strain, add vinegar.

preps.name: Citric acid solution (10%)
steps: Dissolve completely. A few drops brighten a stirred drink; the building block for acid-adjusting.

preps.name: Malic acid solution (10%)
steps: Green-apple sharpness.

preps.name: Lactic acid solution (10%)
steps: Soft, creamy, yogurt-like acidity; good in clear stirred "sours."

preps.name: Tartaric acid solution (10%)
steps: Grape-like acidity; pairs with wine-based drinks.

preps.name: Acid phosphate
steps: Soda-fountain sour without citrus flavor. A few dashes in a highball. Handle concentrated acid with care.

preps.name: Lime acid blend
steps: Roughly lime's acid profile (about 6%). Use with a lime cordial or sugar when there's no fresh lime.

preps.name: Lemon acid blend
steps: Roughly lemon's acid profile.

preps.name: Acid-adjusted orange juice ("lime strength")
steps: Dissolve acids into juice. Brings OJ up to lime-level acidity so it can replace lime in sours; Dave Arnold's method.

preps.name: Acid-adjusted grapefruit juice
steps: Grapefruit at lime strength; makes a sharper Paloma or Brown Derby.

preps.name: Acid-adjusted pineapple juice
steps: Pineapple that drinks like a sour mix.

preps.name: Super juice (lime)
steps: Blend peels and acids into a sherbet, rest 1 hour, blend with the water 30 seconds, strain fine.
Use 1:1 for fresh lime juice. 10 limes make a liter; keeps a week.

preps.name: Super juice (lemon)
steps: Same method as lime super juice. Use 1:1 for lemon juice.

preps.name: Clarified lime juice (centrifuge-free)
steps: Bloom agar in water, boil 1 minute, whisk into room-temperature juice, chill until set. Break up and strain through cloth. Crystal-clear juice for carbonated or clear drinks.

preps.name: Clarified grapefruit (Pectinex)
steps: Stir enzyme into juice, rest 15 minutes, then filter through a coffee filter. Clear juice for highballs and carbonated drinks.

preps.name: Fresh ginger juice
steps: Juice in a press or blend with a splash of water and strain hard. Let the starch settle and pour off.

preps.name: Fresh pineapple juice
steps: Juice, skim the foam if you want it clean (or keep it for texture). Strain.

preps.name: Celery juice
steps: Juice and strain.

preps.name: Saline solution (20%)
steps: Dissolve. 2–4 drops brightens almost any sour; 1–2 drops in stirred drinks.

preps.name: Savory saline (salt and MSG)
steps: Dissolve. For Bloody Marys, Martinis and savory stirred drinks.

preps.name: Chile tincture

ings.t: habaneros or bird's eye chiles, sliced

steps: Steep 24 hours, taste, strain. A few drops adds clean heat.

preps.name: Cinnamon tincture
steps: Steep 1 week, strain.

preps.name: Vanilla tincture
steps: Steep 3–4 weeks, strain (or leave pods in).

preps.name: Coffee tincture
steps: Steep 24 hours, strain.

preps.name: Cacao nib tincture
steps: Steep 1 week, strain. Chocolate notes with no sugar.

preps.name: Bitter orange peel tincture
steps: Steep 1 week, strain. A base for house orange bitters.

preps.name: Gentian tincture
steps: Steep 5 days, strain. Very bitter: a building block for house bitters.

preps.name: Wormwood tincture
steps: Steep 2 days, strain. Absinthe-rinse alternative.

preps.name: Hop tincture
steps: Steep 24 hours, strain. Piney, grapefruit bitterness.

preps.name: Smoked tea tincture (lapsang)
steps: Steep 1 hour, strain. A drop of smoke without a peated scotch.

preps.name: Cardamom tincture
steps: Steep 1 week, strain.

preps.name: Black pepper tincture
steps: Steep 2 days, strain.

preps.name: House orange bitters
steps: Steep peel, spice and gentian in spirit 2 weeks, shaking daily. Strain, add water and syrup, rest 3 days, fine-strain.

preps.name: House aromatic bitters
steps: Steep 2 weeks, strain, add water and syrup, rest, strain again.

preps.name: House celery bitters
steps: Steep 1 week, strain.

preps.name: House mole bitters
steps: Steep 10 days, strain.

preps.name: Jalapeño-infused tequila
steps: Steep 30 minutes to 2 hours, tasting every 30 minutes; strain when the heat is right. Spicy Margarita.

preps.name: Cacao nib rum
steps: Steep 3–5 days, strain.

preps.name: Coffee bourbon
steps: Steep 24 hours, strain. Coffee Old Fashioned.

preps.name: Vanilla bourbon
steps: Steep 3–5 days.

preps.name: Cinnamon whiskey (house)
steps: Steep 2–4 days.

preps.name: Earl Grey gin
steps: Steep 2 hours at room temperature, strain. Earl Grey MarTEAni.

preps.name: Chamomile gin
steps: Steep 2 hours, strain.

preps.name: Pineapple rum (Stiggins-style)
steps: Roast pineapple pieces with a little demerara, steep in the rum 1 week, strain.

preps.name: Strawberry tequila
steps: Steep 2–3 days in the fridge, strain.

preps.name: Cucumber gin
steps: Steep 24 hours, strain.

preps.name: Hibiscus mezcal
steps: Steep 1 hour, strain.

preps.name: Sour cherry bourbon
steps: Steep 1 week, strain.

preps.name: Fig bourbon
steps: Steep 1 week, strain.

preps.name: Spiced apple brandy
steps: Steep 5 days, strain.

preps.name: Rosemary vodka
steps: Steep 24 hours, strain.

preps.name: Butterfly pea gin (color-changing)
steps: Steep 1–2 hours until deep blue, strain. Turns pink when citrus is added.

preps.name: Brown butter bourbon (fat wash)
steps: Brown the butter, pour into the bourbon while warm, stir. Rest 4 hours at room temperature, then freeze overnight. Lift off the fat, strain through a coffee filter.

preps.name: Bacon bourbon (Benton's Old Fashioned)
steps: Warm fat into bourbon, rest 4 hours, freeze, lift fat, strain. Don Lee's Benton's Old Fashioned base.

preps.name: Coconut oil rum
steps: Stir in melted oil, rest 4 hours, freeze, lift solid oil, strain.

preps.name: Olive oil gin
steps: Shake, rest 6 hours, freeze, lift solidified oil, strain. Silky Martinis.

preps.name: Sesame oil whiskey
steps: Stir, rest 4 hours, freeze, strain fine.

preps.name: Peanut butter bourbon
steps: Blend, rest 6 hours, freeze, strain through a coffee filter.

preps.name: Clarified milk punch (English style)
steps: Combine everything but the milk. Pour the punch INTO the warm milk (not the other way) and let it curdle 30 minutes.
Strain through a coffee filter, re-pouring the first cloudy liters back through the curd bed until it runs crystal clear. Bottle; keeps months cold.

preps.name: Clarified pineapple–rum milk punch
steps: Steep cinnamon in the punch 1 hour, remove. Pour into milk, rest 30 minutes, filter until clear.

preps.name: Agar-clarified juice or cocktail (general)
steps: Boil agar in the water 1 minute, whisk into the room-temperature liquid, chill until set, break up and strain through cloth.

preps.name: Egg white foam (batch)
steps: Whisk or iSi-charge for topping. For a single drink just dry-shake 0.75 oz egg white with the cocktail.

preps.name: Aquafaba (vegan foamer)

ings.t: liquid from a can of chickpeas

steps: Reduce by one third over low heat for more foaming power; cool. Use 0.5–0.75 oz per drink in place of egg white.

preps.name: Ginger foam (iSi)
steps: Combine, strain into an iSi siphon, charge with two N2O chargers, shake hard, chill. Dispense over drinks.

preps.name: Lightly whipped cream (Irish Coffee float)
steps: Shake in a sealed container or whisk only until it thickens but still pours. It should float, not stand.

preps.name: Sweet cold foam
steps: Froth with a handheld frother until thick and pourable.

preps.name: Olive brine (house, for Dirty Martinis)
steps: Dissolve. Cleaner and more consistent than jar brine.

preps.name: Pickle brine (Pickleback)
steps: Bring to a simmer, cool, steep 2 days, strain.

preps.name: Bloody Mary mix
steps: Whisk together. Rests well overnight. 4 oz mix to 2 oz vodka.

preps.name: Fresh sour mix (house)
steps: Stir together. For parties only; fresh shaken sours are better.

preps.name: Coconut–lime batch (Painkiller/Colada base)
steps: Whisk until smooth. 4 oz batch to 2 oz rum.

preps.name: House coffee liqueur
steps: Dissolve sugar into warm cold brew, add vanilla and spirit, rest 1 week.

preps.name: Limoncello
steps: Steep zest in spirit 1–2 weeks. Strain, add cooled syrup, rest 1 week. Serve frozen.

preps.name: Nocino (green walnut)
steps: Steep 40 days in the sun, strain, add sugar, age 3+ months.

preps.name: Allspice dram (pimento)

ings.t: Jamaican rum (overproof white or pot still)

steps: Steep allspice in rum 10 days, add cinnamon for the last 2. Strain through a coffee filter, add syrup, rest 2 days.

preps.name: House orange liqueur (dry curaçao style)
steps: Steep zest, peel and cloves in brandy 1 week. Strain, add syrup, rest 3 days.

preps.name: House cherry liqueur
steps: Macerate 2 weeks, strain, add sugar, rest 1 week.

preps.name: Sloe-style gin (with plums or damsons)
steps: Combine and shake every few days for 3 months. Strain and bottle.

preps.name: Brandied cherries (house)
steps: Simmer sugar, water and cinnamon. Add cherries, simmer 5 minutes, off heat add spirit. Jar and refrigerate 1 week before using.

preps.name: Clear ice (directional freezing)
steps: Fill the cooler, freeze 18–24 hours (lid off) so it freezes top-down. Pull before the bottom freezes, rest 10 minutes, cut with a serrated knife and mallet.
Store cut cubes in a sealed bag in the freezer.

preps.name: Cherry soaking syrup (refresh)
steps: Top up jars of cherries; a dash in Manhattans.
